product_adoption.scope: The PRODUCT_ADOPTION phase remains separate and unreleased as a whole. This records only that the first reusable S5 component candidate is released for implementation; it does NOT record S5 acceptance, REUSABLE_ADAPTER_BOUND, composition binding, or any downstream state.
product_adoption.guard_exception: The generation phase guard permits a component directory under src/06_components/ only when generation-state componentization.released_pilots explicitly lists that pilot (currently exactly SRC064, broad_release=false) AND its adoption ledger record exists with matching identity/source_or_codex_id. Adding an adoption ledger record alone does NOT release a new pilot; released pilot set, component directories, and ledger records must match exactly. Any malformed/missing/mismatched generation-state or ledger is a FAIL.
